evidence_quote: based on ISO 50001: 2018 and the Pearce II and Robinson's strategic management model
the plant has not formalized energy target in terms of energy performance indicator and baseline

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper proposes a strategic energy-management framework (EDIM, integrating ISO 50001:2018 with the Pearce II & Robinson strategic-management model) and assesses it qualitatively through expert interviews. It does not present, propose, evaluate, or characterise any EnPI/EnB measurement model (no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach); EnPI and energy baseline appear only as unformalised ISO clause elements. Ineligible under the v2.3 framework-without-measurement-model rule.

paper_type.evidence_quote: this study aims to investigate the design and implementation of strategic energy management system (EDIM) model

stage1.notes: paper_type borderline: single cement plant (PTC, East Java) but core deliverable is a generalisable qualitative strategic framework, so coded framework over 'single applied case'. Set in a cement plant (continuous-process sector); level_3b forced false only by the ineligibility rule, not by sector.
